The Hebrew quotation (four lines of Hebrew text set as a block, Exod. 14. 19–21 with its letter-count) is transcribed as printed; the Hebrew letters, vowels and abbreviations marked [?] are only partly legible at this scan resolution and should be checked against the original. Other doubtful readings: "ÿs" (line 1), "concendit", the letter in parentheses after "secundam ultimi", and the final word of the Hebrew line "Et sic ... quod est". The Latin paragraph is interrupted by the Hebrew block, so the continuing text is set as a new paragraph after it. Catchword "mina" and signature "B 3" are printed at the foot.
